items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: You mean the little Miller you with no legs?

ctx.x: Not Teddy Miller's brother. What? He's no kid to Teddy Miller.
You mean the little Miller you with no legs?
No legs, yeah. No, no. The kid with the no legs. He's daddy had a one man band. Yeah I used to see him by the fair and night.
